summary: Variadic string formatter: initializes a destination pointer and a 0x7FFFFFFF size budget, calls sub_58D04D to format into the destination, decrements the budget to detect underflow, and either invokes sub_58CF35 on overflow or writes a NUL terminator otherwise; returns the sub_58D04D result.

local_names.a2: first fixed argument after which variadic arguments start
local_names.v6: cursor pointer, advanced by sub_58D04D within the destination buffer

operations.description: Start the va_list at a2 and initialize locals: v8/v6 point at destination a1, v9 = 66, v7 = 0x7FFFFFFF.
Call sub_58D04D(&v6, a2, va) to format the variadic arguments into the destination, advancing v6; assign result to v2.
Decrement v7 (--v7) and set v3 when the decrement makes it negative, flagging a remaining-budget underflow.
Branch to the overflow path when v3 (budget underflow) is true.
On the non-overflow path, write a NUL byte (0) at the current cursor position via *v6 = 0.

unresolved: Meaning of the local constant 66 and of the 0x7FFFFFFF budget, and the behavior of sub_58CF35 (overflow handler) and sub_58D04D (formatter) are unknown.
The field evidence field:this:0x00000000 is mapped to the *v6 = 0 write on the assumption that v6 starts at the destination buffer; the packet's field base 'this' may not literally equal a1.
Owning object type is unknown; the packet carries no field records beyond the single byte at offset 0x0.
